Changelog

PKNCA.extra 0.0.0.9022

Bug fixes

  • run_nca() no longer modifies the global PKNCA::PKNCA.options(). The options in effect before the call are restored on exit (also on error). Previously, the NCA specification and settings applied by run_nca() leaked into the session, so that later code reading PKNCA.options() (including get_pk_parameters_from_pknca_options() with options = NULL or with PKNCA.options()$single.dose.aucs passed explicitly) depended on which analyses had been run before. This made results order-dependent, e.g. a test of get_pk_parameters_from_pknca_options() could return c("auclast", "aucinf_obs") instead of the PKNCA default c("auclast", "cmax", "tmax", "half_life", "aucinf_obs") when run after another test that called run_nca().

  • get_pk_parameters_from_pknca_options():

    • only considers logical columns as parameter columns. Previously an interval with start = 1 or end = 1 would return "start"/"end" as parameter names.
    • returns each parameter only once, in order of first appearance.
    • handles specifications with zero intervals (returns character(0)).
    • validates its options and no_dots arguments.
    • documentation now correctly states that no_dots defaults to FALSE.

  • run_nca() called get_treatment_sequence() using partially matched argument names (dat, group); now uses the full names (data, groups).

  • parse_data_for_nca() is now reproducible. The simulated actual time since last dose (ATSLD) was drawn with rnorm() from the session’s random number stream, so output differed between calls. It is now generated using a fixed seed (new argument seed, default 12345) with R’s default random number generators, and the session’s random number state is left untouched. Use seed = NULL for the previous behavior.

Other changes

  • New internal helper restore_pknca_options(). It restores the options atomically (reset to defaults, then a single validated set of all changed options), restores options that are NULL, and does not replay PKNCA validation warnings for saved values (e.g. min.span.ratio < 2), also when options(warn = 2) is set.
  • Minimum R version is now 3.6.0, required for reproducible seeding in parse_data_for_nca() (set.seed(sample.kind = )).
  • Fixed R CMD check NOTEs for undefined global variables in check_nca_grouping(), create_nca_table(), get_nca_individual_fits() and run_nca() (no change in behavior).
  • CLAUDE.md and .claude/ are excluded from the package build.
  • Added tests for get_pk_parameters_from_pknca_options(), set_pknca_interval_parameters(), restore_pknca_options() and parse_data_for_nca(). Tests that modify PKNCA options now restore them.
  • Tests no longer depend on execution order: shared fixtures and helper functions moved from top-level code in test files to helper-*.R files, and test data is created inside each test. Verified with shuffled test order, random file order, and each test file run in isolation.

PKNCA.extra 0.0.0.9021

  • run_nca(partial_auc = ...) now reports PKNCA’s aucint.last.dose (aucint.last without dose data) instead of auclast, interpolating to the end of the interval. AUCtau uses aucint.last.dose for intervals without a concentration measured exactly at the end of the interval, and auclast otherwise. Previously both were biased low when the sample at the end of the interval was drawn late. nca_add_auctau() gains an auc_col argument (#19).
  • run_nca() gives a clear error when PKNCA cannot select any interval from the dosing schedule, and warns when partial_auc is not computed for multi-dose data (#19).
  • Initial CRAN submission.
